name: plamocast
title: Plamocast
description: Japanese ⇄ English translation with swappable backends: local PLaMo 3 Translate (default), any OpenAI-compatible LLM, or DeepL
author: ginga

commands.name: index
commands.title: Translate
commands.subtitle: Plamocast
commands.description: Translate text between Japanese and English with live preview

commands.name: translate-auto
commands.title: Translate Auto (JA ⇄ EN)
commands.subtitle: Plamocast
commands.description: Detect the language of the selected text and translate Japanese → English or English → Japanese

commands.name: translate-to-japanese
commands.title: Translate into Japanese
commands.subtitle: Plamocast
commands.description: Translate the selected text into Japanese

commands.name: translate-to-english
commands.title: Translate into English
commands.subtitle: Plamocast
commands.description: Translate the selected text into English

preferences.name: plamoEndpoint
preferences.title: PLaMo: Endpoint
preferences.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL serving PLaMo 3 Translate (GGUF). LM Studio: http://localhost:1234/v1, Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1

preferences.name: plamoModel
preferences.title: PLaMo: Model
preferences.description: Model identifier of PLaMo 3 Translate on the server

preferences.name: llmEndpoint
preferences.title: LLM: Endpoint
preferences.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL (LM Studio, Ollama, OpenAI, OpenRouter, …)

preferences.name: llmApiKey
preferences.title: LLM: API Key
preferences.description: Sent as a Bearer token. Leave empty for local servers.

preferences.name: llmPrompt
preferences.title: LLM: System Prompt
preferences.description: Optional custom system prompt. {{target}} becomes Japanese/English, {{style}} the Japanese style instruction. Empty uses the built-in prompt.

preferences.name: deeplApiKey
preferences.title: DeepL: API Key
preferences.description: DeepL API authentication key (Free keys end with :fx)

preferences.name: source
preferences.title: Preferred Source
preferences.description: Where to read the text from. Falls back to the other source when empty.

preferences.name: onTranslateAction
preferences.title: On Translation Action
preferences.description: What the quick (no-view) commands do with the translation
